source_note: 一致几乎处处有界函数列算术平均值几乎处处收敛的问题
english_source_note: A.e. Convergence of Cesaro Means of Uniformly a.e. Bounded Functions
callout_id: 一致几乎处处有界函数列算术平均值几乎处处收敛的问题#1
english_title: Proposition 0, CMC Mathematics Group Senior Final Problem
statement_en:
Let $(X,\Omega,\mu)$ be a measure space, and let $f_n$ be a sequence of measurable functions on $X$ that is almost everywhere uniformly bounded. Define $A_N(x):=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n\leq N} f_n(x)$. Then
$$\sum_{N\geq 1} \frac{1}{N}\int_X A_{N}^{2}(x)\,d\mu <\infty\implies A_N(x)\xrightarrow{a.e.}{0}.$$
key_techniques: maximal control from averaged square bounds
callout_body: $(X,\Omega,\mu)$是一个测度空间，$f_n$是$X$上一列几乎处处一致有界的可测函数列。令$A_N(x):=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n\leq N} f_n(x)$那么$$\sum_{N\geq 1} \frac{1}{N}\int_X A_{N}^{2}(x)\,d\mu <\infty\implies A_N(x)\xrightarrow{a.e.}{0}$$
